title: control_medico.dictamen.created v1
description: Emitted when an occupational-health dictamen is created. Derived from the REAL producer alebrije-mod-control-medico dictamenes.py:98-115 (emit_event/outbox, ADR-57). PHI-SAFE BY DESIGN: the producer currently includes raw 'diagnostico'/'observaciones'/'resultado' (dictamenes.py:105-107) which MUST be stripped on adoption — only identifiers + non-clinical metadata travel the bus (HIPAA/NOM-024), mirroring control_medico.consultation.completed.v1.json. Producer also currently emits the legacy short event_type 'dictamen.created' (events.py:96) and must migrate to this canonical name. Source: alebrije-mod-control-medico (Python).

paciente_id.description: Patient/worker UUID the dictamen is about (dictamenes.py:103). Nullable per producer.

data.description: PHI-SAFE subset ONLY. The producer's raw 'diagnostico'/'observaciones'/'resultado' fields (dictamenes.py:105-107) are deliberately EXCLUDED and must not be emitted on the bus (HIPAA/NOM-024). additionalProperties:false enforces no PHI leakage.
